name: @ilyautov/cordon
description: A deterministic policy gate for observable AI agent actions, with no AI inside. For Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness, Gemini CLI, MCP hosts and LangChain.
author: Ilya Utov (https://github.com/ilyautov)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/no-invisible.mjs && npm run test:package
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=plugin/dist/cli.js --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cordonRequire}from'node:module';const require=__cordonRequire(import.meta.url);" && echo '{ "type": "module" }' > plugin/dist/package.json && chmod +x plugin/dist/cli.js
